taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts S. rugosa and recognizes infraspecific variation; Texas is within the species-level native range.

target_zone_range.evidence_basis: The project has one wild observation, but this pass did not lock three exact target-zone counties under the current species concept.
target_zone_range.guardrail: Do not infer target-zone occurrence from species-level Texas nativity.

morphology.look_here_first: Wrinkleleaf goldenrod is a rhizomatous perennial with conspicuously rugose/wrinkled leaves, hairy stems, and plume-like yellow inflorescences; confirm leaf texture and stem pubescence rather than flower color alone.
